args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am inquiring about availability for a group stay of 10 people in June. Could you please provide information on room options, rates, and any group-specific amenities or requirements?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
